name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited during the televised coverage of the Dakar Rally in his native Chile. Witnessing the blend of raw mechanical prowess and strategic navigation sparked a desire to understand the intricate details of vehicle performance. He began his career working on rally cars, honing his skills in data analysis and vehicle dynamics. Ricardo transitioned to circuit racing, where he quickly established himself as a meticulous and dependable engineer. He favors a holistic approach, considering all factors impacting a vehicle's performance, from aerodynamic efficiency to driver feedback. He is known for his exceptional ability to diagnose subtle mechanical issues that often elude other engineers. While Ricardo values teamwork, he often works independently during the initial phases of problem-solving, preferring to rely on his own analysis before seeking input from others.

Sepúlveda's distinctive approach lies in his commitment to continuous improvement. He meticulously documents every adjustment and its impact, building a vast library of knowledge that he regularly references. Ricardo's ability to see the big picture allows him to identify areas where marginal gains can accumulate into significant performance advantages. He strives to get every last ounce of performance out of the car, and he is known to be a hard worker.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave on top
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium height with a sturdy build and a weathered face that reflects years spent trackside.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Insists on using analog gauges alongside digital displays; trusts his gut.
Sharpens his pencils obsessively before important sessions.
